_comment: Manually-curated tweets that the X API did not return. Each entry is run through the same classifier and merged with the auto-fetched dataset. Tweets flagged here appear in the table with a 'manually added' badge so readers can audit. To add a tweet: copy its ID from the URL (e.g. x.com/SenatorWong/status/<ID>), paste the full tweet text, set created_at to the tweet's timestamp in ISO 8601 UTC form. Schema: tweets[]: {id, created_at, text, added_by?, note?}.
